column1: # Custom layout that gives the firmware plenty of room (1.25MB) and a
# generous but not extravagant LittleFS region (1.0MB). The full 4MB flash
# is used: nvs + otadata + app0 + app1 + littlefs + coredump.
# Note: ESP32 partition tool uses 'spiffs' as the SubType even when the
# filesystem is LittleFS — the SubType just declares it as a generic
# filesystem area; the actual format (SPIFFS vs LittleFS) is chosen at
# upload time by mklittlefs/mkspiffs and at runtime by the firmware.
